links.comparator_used: Standard double reading by radiologists without AI
links.outcome: Breast cancer detection rate (with recall rate, PPV of recall and PPV of biopsy)
links.effect: Detection rate 6.7 vs 5.7 per 1,000, 17.6% higher (95% CI +5.7%, +30.8%). Recall rate 37.4 vs 38.3 per 1,000 (difference -2.5% (-6.5%, +1.7%)), noninferior. PPV of recall 17.9% vs 14.9%. PPV of biopsy 64.5% vs 59.2%.
links.quote: Compared to standard double reading, AI-supported double reading was associated with a higher breast cancer detection rate without negatively affecting the recall rate, strongly indicating that AI can improve mammography screening metrics.

design_hint: AI-supported double reading with radiologist review (vs standard double reading)
